question: In which year was Microsoft’s Windows operating system first introduced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1985**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1985**__, Microsoft’s Windows operating system was first introduced.
 
• Microsoft introduced Windows as a graphical operating system shell for MS-DOS in response to the growing interest in graphical user interfaces.
 
• As of October 2021, the most recent version of Windows for PCs and tablets is Windows 11, version 21H2.
 
• An operating system is a system software or an interface between a computer user and computer hardware. It basically to communicate with the computer.
 
• An operating system performs tasks like file management, memory management, process management, handling input and output, and controlling peripheral devices.
